hypotheses.dynamic: Paper-based Dynamic CNN reconstruction with K=4 kernels per layer.
hypotheses.dynamic_stats: Mean plus standard deviation of feature channels may improve input-dependent kernel selection; may also increase sensitivity to domain statistics.
hypotheses.dynamic_balance: A small KL penalty on batch-mean router weights may limit early expert collapse; excessive balancing may prevent useful specialization.

selection: Report every predeclared variant. Any winner is selected by mean source validation balanced accuracy, never external scores.
